description.value:
Requirements Your waking world is active.

Dust and pollen fill your waking world, obscuring creatures from sight. All creatures within your waking world become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed], and all creatures outside the area become concealed to creatures within it until the start of your next turn. In addition, a creature that ends its turn in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw against your world rouser DC as it inhales the particles. On a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] until the end of its next turn or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded] on a critical failure.
